data.title: W / 维什戴尔 · 咖啡里的谜底
data.description: 她隔着杯沿看你，挑眉问刚才那句话是不是认真的。你一迟疑，她便倾身凑近，等你重新回答。
data.action: 隔着杯沿挑眉，身体微微前倾
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Across a small round café table in a retro diner, W leans forward over two steaming ceramic mugs, propping her chin on her palm while raising an eyebrow with a teasing, provocative smirk. Warm overhead incandescent lamps cast amber reflections across the vinyl tabletop and polished cutlery, with rain softly pattering against the diner window behind her.
